text:
Interviewed daughter-in-law.
Mother (Head) terrified of having
billetees, also deaf ∴ no answer to
her door. ∴ enquired from next door
& found that daughter in law lived
3 doors down. She was friendly &
answered all questions. ∴ House not
inspected. Husband of head when alive
looked after house well ("a handy man").
Very neat exterior - lawn in 2 plots in front.
Head eats practically all meals at son's house.
Block = 40' x 112'.
